## Purpose and entry points
DeerFlow 2.0 is an open-source “super agent harness” for running LangGraph/LangChain agents with tools, skills, subagents, memory, sandboxes, channels, and durable runs. The normal application entry is the Gateway API behind nginx, with a Next.js workspace UI. It also supports an embedded Python client and terminal UI.
- Gateway: `backend/app/gateway/app.py`
- Embedded client: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/client.py`
- TUI: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/tui/__main__.py`
- Web application: `frontend/src/app/workspace/page.tsx`

## Gateway, API, and access boundary
The Python Gateway owns HTTP lifecycle, authentication/CSRF middleware, authorization, native API routers, and LangGraph-compatible API translation. It is the boundary between browsers, IM/GitHub sources, and agent execution. Routers cover threads/runs, artifacts, uploads, agents, models, skills, MCP, scheduled tasks, and integrations.
- App composition: `backend/app/gateway/app.py`
- Run APIs: `backend/app/gateway/routers/runs.py`
- Authentication and authorization: `backend/app/gateway/auth_middleware.py`, `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/authz/enforcement.py`

## Agent construction and execution pipeline
A lead-agent factory builds LangGraph agents from configured models, tools, skills, middleware, memory, and optional custom-agent state. The middleware chain governs context injection/compaction, skill and tool policies, sandbox auditing, safety termination, tool failures, token budgets, clarification, and subagent limits. The runtime worker executes a run, streams events, checkpoints state, and records completion.
- Lead agent: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/agents/lead_agent/agent.py`
- Agent factory: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/agents/factory.py`
- Run worker/manager: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/runtime/runs/worker.py`, `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/runtime/runs/manager.py`
- Middleware boundary: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/agents/middlewares/`

## Durable state, streaming, and multi-worker control
Run state is separated into LangGraph checkpoint/store infrastructure, application persistence, event storage, and stream delivery. SQLite is supported locally; PostgreSQL enables shared production state. Redis can provide cross-worker stream bridging, checkpoint caching, and sandbox ownership. Multi-worker execution requires durable run ownership and database-backed events.
- Persistence bootstrap and SQL models: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/persistence/bootstrap.py`, `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/persistence/run/sql.py`
- Checkpoint providers: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/runtime/checkpointer/provider.py`
- Event stores: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/runtime/events/store/db.py`
- Redis stream bridge: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/runtime/stream_bridge/redis.py`

## Capability plane: tools, MCP, sandbox, and subagents
Tools combine built-ins, web/search providers, filesystem operations, configured MCP servers, and skills. Sandboxes isolate per-thread files and command execution through local, Docker/AIO, E2B, or provisioner backends. The lead agent delegates selected work to isolated subagent graphs; their internal messages remain out of the parent transcript.
- Tool assembly: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/tools/tools.py`
- MCP client/task runtime: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/client.py`, `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/tasks/runtime.py`
- Sandbox abstraction: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/sandbox/sandbox_provider.py`
- Delegation execution: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/subagents/executor.py`

## Memory, skills, extensions, and model providers
Long-term memory is pluggable (default DeerMem, plus Mem0, Honcho, OpenViking, or no-op) and is injected or exposed as tools depending on mode. Skills are user-scoped packages with progressive discovery, validation, policy enforcement, and sandbox projection. Extensions can contribute middleware, lifecycle hooks, services, and authenticated Gateway routers. Model factories support OpenAI-compatible, Claude, Codex CLI, vLLM, and patched providers.
- Memory manager: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/agents/memory/manager.py`
- Skill catalog/policy: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/skills/catalog.py`, `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/skills/tool_policy.py`
- Extension loader: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/extensions/loader.py`
- Model factory: `backend/packages/harness/deerflow/models/factory.py`

## Delivery surfaces and infrastructure
The Next.js frontend renders streamed thread state, artifacts, browser controls, task status, settings, and scheduled tasks through Gateway APIs. IM channel adapters ingest provider messages, deduplicate and queue them, then invoke Gateway-internal LangGraph endpoints. Docker Compose runs frontend, Gateway, nginx, and optional services; Helm defines Kubernetes deployments including PostgreSQL, Redis, and a sandbox provisioner.
- Workspace chat UI: `frontend/src/components/workspace/chats/chat-page.tsx`
- Frontend API client: `frontend/src/core/api/api-client.ts`
- Channel service: `backend/app/channels/service.py`
- Deployment: `docker/docker-compose.yaml`, `deploy/helm/deer-flow/templates/gateway-deployment.yaml`
